business.deleteConfirm: Are you sure? This cannot be undone.
business.infoOnly: CityJoy is only an information platform; any agreement and payment is between you and the business.
business.rankingBody: At most 2 cards labelled "Ad" appear at the top (only businesses with verified documents). All others follow the same rule for everyone: businesses with verified documents first, then review score (the number of reviews counts too), then those in your district, then the most recently updated. Membership plans do not change the order.
business.notFound: This business was not found or is not published.
business.unverifiedWarning: Be careful with unverified businesses; confirm identity and price in advance.
business.myVerifyNote: After saving your business you can request verification from its edit screen. Until verified it is listed as "Not verified".
business.noProvince: Choose your location to see businesses.
business.removedNote: This business was removed by CityJoy. Contact CityJoy for details.
business.duplicatePhone: A business with this phone number is already registered. If it's yours, contact CityJoy.
business.verifyIntro: Verified businesses come first in lists and get the "Documents verified" label. Your request goes to your province manager first, then to CityJoy; you may be contacted by phone or video call.
business.verifyPendingFirst: Request received, waiting for the province manager's review.
business.verifyPendingAdmin: Approved by the province manager, waiting for CityJoy's final approval.

reviews.hiddenNote: This review of yours was hidden by CityJoy.

sos.title: SOS - Alert my family
sos.disclaimerTitle: This is not an official emergency call
sos.disclaimer: In a life-threatening emergency, call 112. SOS only sends your location to people on your family list; no emergency service is notified.
sos.noFamily: No one is on your family list. Add a family member to send SOS. In an emergency, call 112.
sos.locationDenied: Location permission was not given. SOS will be sent without location.
sos.locationUnavailable: Location unavailable. SOS will be sent without location.
sos.pressHint: Tapping starts a {{seconds}}-second countdown; you can cancel if you pressed by mistake.
sos.testHint: Goes to your family members labelled "TEST", to see how it works.
sos.historyNote: Records are deleted automatically after 30 days.
sos.timeout: Sending could not be confirmed; you seem to be offline. Call 112 now.
sos.sendError: SOS could not be sent. Call 112 now.
sos.notFound: This SOS record was not found or was deleted.
sos.pushHelpBody: SOS: tap to see their location.
sos.readyIntro: Give the permissions now so no time is lost in an emergency.
sos.readyNotify: Notifications (your phone rings if family sends SOS)
sos.readyBackground: Location: "Always" (your location is sent even when the screen is locked)
sos.readyPhoneOnly: These settings are made in the phone app.
sos.noPush: Family members who won't get a notification: {{names}}. They will only see the SOS when they open the app; call them if you can.
sos.backgroundOn: Your location keeps being shared even if the screen locks or the app closes.
sos.backgroundOff: No background location permission: your location only updates while this screen is open.
sos.fgTitle: SOS: sharing your location with your family
sos.fgBody: If you are safe, tap "I'm safe" in the app.
